question: 각 언어별로 등록된 영화 수는?
sql: SELECT l.name AS language_name, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film f JOIN language l ON f.language_id = l.language_id GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY film_count DESC, language_name ASC;

question: 반납되지 않은 대여 건수는?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unreturned_rentals FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NULL;

question: 2006년 2월에 결제한 고객 수는?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2006-02-01' AND payment_date < '2006-03-01';

question: 교체 비용(replacement_cost)이 가장 높은 영화 10개의 제목과 비용을 보여줘
sql: SELECT film_id, title, replacement_cost FROM film ORDER BY replacement_cost DESC, title ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 대여 기간(rental_duration)이 7일 이상인 영화는 몇 편인가요?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 7;

question: 평점(rating)별 평균 상영 시간(length)은?
sql: SELECT rating, ROUND(AVG(length), 2) AS avg_length FROM film GROUP BY rating ORDER BY avg_length DESC, rating ASC;

question: 특정 배우(예: last_name이 'MONROE')가 출연한 영화 제목 목록을 보여줘
sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id WHERE a.last_name = 'MONROE' ORDER BY f.title;

question: 배우 성(last_name)별 배우 수 상위 10개는?
sql: SELECT last_name, COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM actor GROUP BY last_name ORDER BY actor_count DESC, last_name ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 고객 중 이메일이 NULL인 사람 수는?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_email FROM customer WHERE email IS NULL;

question: 도시(city)별 고객 수 상위 10개를 구해줘
sql: SELECT ci.city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON cu.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id GROUP BY ci.city ORDER BY customer_count DESC, ci.city ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 국가(country)별 총 결제 금액 상위 10개는?
sql: SELECT co.country, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_paid FROM payment p JOIN customer cu ON p.customer_id = cu.customer_id JOIN address a ON cu.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY total_paid DESC, co.country ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 매장(store)별 인벤토리 수는?
sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS inventory_count FROM inventory GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY inventory_count DESC, store_id ASC;

question: 매장별로 서로 다른 영화(film_id) 종류는 몇 개씩 있나요?
sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS distinct_films FROM inventory GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY distinct_films DESC, store_id ASC;

question: 카테고리별 영화 평균 대여료(rental_rate)는?
sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(AVG(f.rental_rate), 2) AS avg_rental_rate FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_rental_rate DESC, category_name ASC;

question: 카테고리별 영화 평균 교체 비용(replacement_cost)은?
sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(AVG(f.replacement_cost), 2) AS avg_replacement_cost FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_replacement_cost DESC, category_name ASC;

question: 고객별 총 결제 금액의 순위를 매겨 상위 20명을 보여줘(윈도우 함수 사용)
sql: SELECT customer_id, total_paid, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_paid DESC) AS paid_rank FROM (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_paid FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) t ORDER BY paid_rank ASC LIMIT 20;

question: 직원(staff)별 결제 처리 금액 합계는?
sql: SELECT staff_id, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM payment GROUP BY staff_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC, staff_id ASC;

question: 직원별로 처리한 대여 건수는?
sql: SELECT staff_id, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental GROUP BY staff_id ORDER BY rental_count DESC, staff_id ASC;

question: 대여일 기준으로 가장 최근 대여 10건을 보여줘
sql: SELECT rental_id, rental_date, customer_id, inventory_id, staff_id FROM rental ORDER BY rental_date DESC LIMIT 10;

question: 결제일 기준으로 가장 최근 결제 10건을 보여줘
sql: SELECT payment_id, payment_date, customer_id, rental_id, amount FROM payment ORDER BY payment_date DESC LIMIT 10;

question: 영화별로 인벤토리(재고) 수가 1개뿐인 영화는?
sql: SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title HAVING COUNT(i.inventory_id) = 1 ORDER BY f.title;

question: 고객별 대여 후 반납까지 평균 소요 시간(일 단위)은?
sql: SELECT customer_id, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (return_date - rental_date)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_days_to_return FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY avg_days_to_return DESC NULLS LAST, customer_id ASC;

question: 카테고리별 대여 건수는?
sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY rental_count DESC, category_name ASC;

question: 특정 카테고리(예: 'Horror')에서 상영 시간이 150분 이상인 영화 제목을 보여줘
sql: SELECT f.title, f.length FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Horror' AND f.length >= 150 ORDER BY f.length DESC, f.title ASC;

question: 고객 활성 여부(activebool)별 고객 수를 구해줘
sql: SELECT activebool, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY activebool ORDER BY activebool DESC;

question: 도시별 매장 수는?
sql: SELECT ci.city, COUNT(*) AS store_count FROM store s JOIN address a ON s.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id GROUP BY ci.city ORDER BY store_count DESC, ci.city ASC;

question: 국가별 매장 수는?
sql: SELECT co.country, COUNT(*) AS store_count FROM store s JOIN address a ON s.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY store_count DESC, co.country ASC;

question: 특정 고객(예: customer_id=1)의 월별 결제 금액과 누적 결제 금액을 구해줘
sql: SELECT month, monthly_paid, SUM(monthly_paid) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_paid FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS monthly_paid FROM payment WHERE customer_id = 1 GROUP BY month) t ORDER BY month;

question: 영화별 대여 횟수와 평균 결제 금액을 함께 구해줘
sql: SELECT f.film_id, f.title, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count, ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS avg_payment FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id LEFT JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY rental_count DESC, f.title ASC LIMIT 50;

question: 고객별로 마지막 결제일과 마지막 대여일을 함께 구해줘
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, MAX(p.payment_date) AS last_payment_date, MAX(r.rental_date) AS last_rental_date FROM customer c LEFT JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id LEFT JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY c.customer_id ASC;
